name: 88e90d21-c4ee-463a-97c9-12cc8e7ac5f5
description:
Initiate an Outgoing Call: Look up and retrieve the patient and appointment details for a specified call ID, which the voicebot will use to start a conversation with the patient.

Report the Outcome: Receive the patient's confirmation response ("oui" or "non") for their scheduled appointment after the voicebot completes the call.

Endpoint: /bot/outgoinginit (POST)
Summary: Initiate Outgoing Call and Retrieve Patient/Exam Details

This endpoint is the first step in the outgoing call process. The calling system (e.g., the voicebot platform) sends a pre-assigned CallId in the request body. Dictaticket uses this ID to retrieve and return all necessary details about the scheduled appointment, including the Patient_Name, Patient_PhoneNumber, Exam_Type, Exam_Date, and Exam_Time. This information allows the voicebot to properly address the patient and state the purpose of the call.

Request Payload: Requires a JSON object with the unique CallId.
Success Response (200): Returns a JSON object containing the call-specific details.

Endpoint: /bot/outgoingresponse (POST)
Summary: Submit Patient's Confirmation Response

This endpoint is used after the voicebot has completed the outgoing call and successfully elicited a confirmation response from the patient. The calling system sends the CallId along with the patient's confirmation decision in the Patient_Confirmation field, which must be either oui (yes) or non (no). This finalizes the outcome of the automated call within the Dictaticket system.

Request Payload: Requires a JSON object with the CallId and the Patient_Confirmation (which must be 'oui' or 'non').
Success Response (200): Acknowledges successful receipt of the confirmation response.
